title: *EASIEST* COFFEE ALMOND CAKE AT HOME #shorts
description:
Episode 12 of MICROWAVE MAGIC✨a series where I make your favourite desserts at home only in a microwave 🙌🏻Weekend calls for a slice of something warm and comforting💁🏻‍♂️ This Coffee Almond Cake is made with whole wheat, has no maida and no refined sugar, it makes for the perfect little bake to brighten up your dessert time instantly☕

Ingredients
1 cup milk, warm
½ tbsp vinegar
2 tsp coffee powder
¾ cup dates powder
¼ cup oil
2 tbsp yogurt
¾ cup whole wheat flour
½ tsp baking soda
⅓ cup toasted almonds, chopped

Instructions
1. Add vinegar, coffee and milk in a medium sized bowl. Let it sit for 5-7 minutes till the milk curdles.
2. Add dates powder, oil and yogurt to the same bowl and whisk really well.
3. Add whole wheat flour and baking soda and whisk until just combined.
4. Spread the batter evenly once and add the chopped almonds on top.
5. Microwave the cake on regular heating mode for 6 minutes on until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean.
